lastCompletedStory.title: Persist MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT promotion in runSupervisor so cap-reentry exits terminal and ship accepts it

nextStoryContext: US-002 wired the cap-REENTRY promotion in loop.ts: when decideNextAction returns complete or await-operator with promoteVerdictTo==='MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT', the loop now writes prd.review.lastVerdict='MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT' and calls notifyOrchestrator BEFORE the terminal return. The US-006 post-review promotion path (loop.ts ~1115-1148) was NOT touched. All 9 tests in test/supervisor/non-convergence-terminal.test.ts pass (5 original US-006 + 4 new US-002). makeHasPendingStories correctly returns false on a promoted prd. Both PRD stories (US-001 and US-002) now have passes:true; the PRD is complete.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure TypeScript logic change to loop.ts top-of-loop terminal handlers and corresponding behavioral tests. No external libraries involved; node:fs built-ins (writeFileSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync) used in test fixtures are standard Bun-compatible APIs.
